info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_ATM Network Operations Status API
info.description: The ATM Network Operations Status API provides real-time insights into the operational status of ATM services within specified banking channels. This endpoint enables users to access crucial information regarding the availability and functionality of ATMs, ensuring efficient access for customers. Typical consumers include banking institutions, financial service providers, and integration platforms that require up-to-date ATM status to enhance user experience and operational reliability. By leveraging this data, businesses can proactively manage ATM networks and promptly address issues affecting service delivery.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of ATM network operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the current status of ATM network operations, providing insights into operational efficiency and any issues that may be affecting network performance.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the ATM network operations status. This body should contain the necessary parameters to specify the operation type and any filters or identifiers relevant to the request.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the status of ATM network operations.

GetAtmNetworkOperationsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation status within the ATM network operations. It accepts a string value.
